title: Efficient Pairwise Difference Learning: A Comparative Study of Encoding Strategies and Training Pair Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.21644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification (PDC) enhances supervised learning in low-data regimes by training a binary similarity classifier on pairs of instances rather than individual samples, effectively inflating the training set from $n$ to $O(n^2)$ examples. However, the PDC framework leaves critical implementation choices underspecified, particularly regarding input representation and pair selection strategies. This work systematically investigates these design decisions through extensive empirical evaluation. We compare four feature encoders (paired features, triplet with relative difference, absolute difference, and a novel triplet with absolute difference) alongside four pair selection strategies ranging from exhaustive to kernel-thinning-based schemes. translated_title: 高效成对差分学习：编码策略与训练样本对选择的比较研究
translated_abstract: 用于分类的成对差分学习通过在实例对而非单个样本上训练二元相似性分类器，增强了低数据量场景下的监督学习，有效地将训练集从 $n$ 个样本扩充至 $O(n^2)$ 个样本。然而，PDC 框架在关键实现选择上缺乏明确规范，特别是在输入表示和样本对选择策略方面。本工作通过广泛的实证评估系统地研究了这些设计决策。我们比较了四种特征编码器（成对特征、相对差分三元组、绝对差分，以及一种新颖的绝对差分三元组），并结合四种样本对选择策略（从穷举法到基于核稀疏化的方案）进行了对比。实验涵盖了近 200 个基准分类数据集，使用决策树、多层感知机、高斯朴素贝叶斯和支持向量分类器作为基础模型……
tldr: 该研究通过在近200个基准数据集上的大规模实验，系统比较了成对差分学习（PDC）中四种特征编码方法与四种样本对选择策略，为低数据量分类任务确定了最优实现方案。
en_tdlr: This work systematically compares four feature encoders and four pair selection strategies for Pairwise Difference Learning (PDC) across nearly 200 benchmark datasets to identify optimal implementation choices for low-data classification.
